{{Quote|I booked passage on this transport!|The unidentified Snivvian passenger, to a clone trooper|<ref name="Cut and Run" />}}
A [[Snivvian]] [[Gender|male]] '''individual''' made an attempt to leave the [[planet]] [[Saleucami]] shortly after the [[Proclamation of the New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Directly following a holographic broadcast by Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]], the passenger attempted to board a [[Star Commuter 2000]] [[transport]] and was stopped by a [[clone trooper]], who asserted to him the Empire's new [[chain code]] requirement for offworld travel. The Snivvian then protested that he had to get on the [[starship]], attempting to resist the trooper and board the transport to no avail. After being pushed to the ground and told to get back in line by the clone trooper, the Snivvian left the scene. All of this was witnessed by [[Cloning|clone]] [[Treason|defectors]] [[Hunter]] and [[Cut Lawquane]].<ref name="Cut and Run" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Snivvian passenger first appeared in "[[Cut and Run]]," the second episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''. He was voiced by [[Noshir Dalal]], who also voiced Vice Admiral Edmon Rampart.<ref name="Cut and Run" />
